Tipsoi Driver

W/S or arrows: accelerate and brake · A/D: steer · Space: handbrake · H: horn · C: camera · V: vehicle · M: map · T: time · G: weather · R: reset · Esc: pause/settings · P: Tipsoi products.

Mobile: use the on-screen steering and pedals. For smoother play, use a browser with hardware graphics acceleration and keep mirrors off.

Game adapted from Ostad Driver. Product branding and artwork: Tipsoi.
